name: govisit-travel-planner
description: Discover destinations and research places, categories, collections, and activities using GoVisit.

interface.longDescription: Research travel ideas using GoVisit destination and place profiles, categories, collections, activities, and visit facts. Includes 18 public read skills for travel planners and requires no GoVisit API key. Published information does not establish live prices or availability. This package cannot edit profiles or make reservations.
